text:
Alex: Quick proposal  try a short-cycle follow-up for postmortems to avoid stalled action items. Proposal: 72h checkpoint, 2-week remediation sprint, 8-week recurrence review.
Maya: +1. Keep the 72h lightweight: status + blocker. :ok_hand:
Priya: Agree. Can you put a tiny template people can paste? adoption is easier if it's short.
Alex: Drafting a compact timeline/template below  minimal fields so it's fast to update inline. Paste and tell me what to tweak:
```
Compact PM follow-up template
- T+0 (postmortem published): assign primary owner, buddy, and due date
- Owner field (required): name
- Impact estimate (required): low / med / high; dev hours estimate
- T+72h: quick status (on-track / blocked / needs help)  1 line
- T+7d: mitigation PR link or progress note
- T+14d: remediation sprint end  close if done or document extension + reason
- T+28d: alert replay / regression check
- T+56d: recurrence pattern review & escalate if repeated
Automation: oncall-bot pings at T+72h & T+14d
Comm: pin status in PR and post a short thread update
Suggested T+72h message: "Status: on-track. PR: <link>. Blockers: none."
```
Omar: Recommend adding a Jira label (pm-remediation) so the oncall dashboard surfaces tickets. Also add an Impact estimate field (low/med/high + hours)  helps prioritization.
Maya: For comms cadence, propose: Execs get a weekly summary until closure; Eng channels get T+72h and T+14d updates.
Priya: Rotation thought: make IC rotation 1 week default; allow a 3-week overlap handoff mode during busy periods. IC should be listed on postmortem root so follow-ups know whom to ping.
Alex: Will wire oncall-bot hooks: \n- @oncall-bot remind #private-action-tracker T+72h "PM follow-up: <link>"\n- @oncall-bot remind <owner> T+14d "Remediation due"\noncall-bot: Reminder scheduled: T+72h ping set for thread 1941209000.
Priya: Also propose a small T+28d script that replays incident signals and surfaces regressions automatically.
EngLead: Pilot this for the next 6 incidents. Track metrics: time-to-close, % with owner assigned within 24h, recurrence within 8 weeks.
Maya: I'll coordinate the pilot and collect the metrics.
Alex: I'll update the process doc and add the compact template + example checklist: https://docs.internal/redwood/incident-followup-template
Priya: One more: recommend owners include an estimated completion ETA in the PR description to keep expectations clear.
Alex: Done. Let's run pilot and reconvene after 6 incidents to iterate on cadence and fields. :rocket:
